newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas down after TransCo flexibility sal.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas down after TransCo flexibility sal.

text.p: IPE British natural gas futures lost more ground on Monday after BG plc's transport arm TransCo sold marginal gas supplies at a loss on the so-called flexibility market over the weekend.
Dealers said the infant IPE contract was sidelined after the Transco sales. Only 70 IPE lots traded in total.
March IPE gas fell 0.6 pence to nine pence a therm and contracts further out fell by between 0.28 pence and 0.4 pence.
"It wasn't a good day for the IPE contract," said a broker. "It was completely flummoxed by the TransCo flexibility sales."

The flexibility market allows for internal balancing in the UK's gas pipeline system. Some of TransCo's lowest sales effectively were paying for companies to take the gas off TransCo's hands, the traders said.
